brief:
Palestine National University announced the opening of admissions and registration for new students in the first semester of the 2026-2027 academic year, according to Maan Wire. The university is accepting applications across doctorate, master's, bachelor's, and associate diploma programs in multiple specializations.

The institution said it provides scholarships and financial assistance to eligible students. The university emphasized its qualified faculty members, modern facilities, and academic environment designed to support student development. Registration began for the upcoming academic cycle.
title: Palestine National University opens 2026-27 admissions for graduate and undergraduate degrees.
